description: Source code for transaction management in the etcd key-value store, including read/write transactions, range queries, and key modifications within the mvcc package.

classes.name: storeTxnRead
classes.description: Represents a read-only transaction in the store, providing methods to access revision info and range queries.

classes.name: storeTxnCommon
classes.description: Common transaction data shared between read and write transactions, including revision info and trace.

classes.name: storeTxnWrite
classes.description: Represents a write transaction, supporting key-value modifications, deletions, and revision management.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Initiates a read-only transaction with specified mode and trace.

methods.name: FirstRev
methods.description: Returns the first revision number of the transaction.

methods.name: Rev
methods.description: Returns the current revision number of the transaction.

methods.name: Range
methods.description: Performs a range query over keys within the transaction context.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Creates a new write transaction with trace.

methods.name: Rev
methods.description: Returns the beginning revision of the write transaction.

methods.name: Range
methods.description: Performs a range query within a write transaction.

methods.name: DeleteRange
methods.description: Deletes a range of keys within the transaction.

methods.name: Put
methods.description: Inserts or updates a key-value pair within the transaction.

methods.name: End
methods.description: Completes the write transaction, updating revision and releasing locks.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Internal method to add a key-value pair to the transaction, handling lease attachment/detachment.

methods.name: deleteRange
methods.description: Deletes a range of keys from the store.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a single key from the store.

methods.name: Changes
methods.description: Returns the list of key-value changes made in the transaction.
